notes: Existing stories fully cover schema, core logic, API, integration, and testing. No gaps identified.

FIND-P-M1-S1.title: Define Provider Search Schema and Contract
FIND-P-M1-S1.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty hints) and outputs (ranked providers, metadata, attribution of vector vs taxonomy match). Enforce strict validation and compatibility with tool_router.

FIND-P-M1-S2.title: Implement Vector + Taxonomy Provider Search Logic
FIND-P-M1-S2.description: Implement provider search using MongoDB Atlas vector search with deterministic fallback to NUCC taxonomy matching. Define ranking precedence and include multi-stage geographic filtering (state/city/county).

FIND-P-M1-S3.title: Expose Provider Search via FindCareFacade
FIND-P-M1-S3.description: Integrate provider search into FindCareFacade with strict orchestration: specialty identification → query expansion → search execution → response shaping. Expose via FastAPI endpoint wired through tool_router for chat tool-use compatibility.

FIND-P-M1-S4.title: Provider Search Unit and Integration Tests
FIND-P-M1-S4.description: Create unit and integration tests covering vector search, taxonomy fallback, geo filtering, empty results, and low-confidence scenarios. Validate end-to-end flow from tool_router through facade to service.

FIND-P-M1-S5.title: Integrate Specialty Identification with NUCC Mapping
FIND-P-M1-S5.description: Integrate specialty_service to extract specialties via regex + vector pipelines, map to NUCC codes, deduplicate, and aggregate into normalized inputs for provider search.
